reviews.title: Cost-effective and works very well
reviews.comment:
I did a good bit of research and decided for performance and price, this would be the best CPU for me.
However, it still does NOT taste good in a sandwich. Seeing that wasn't its intended purpose though, I guess I'll be nice.
reviews.author: Joshua Taylor

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.comment: This item arrived defective. It was shipped in a brown non-Intel box and was poorly packaged - the CPU was not secured in any way! The seller misrepresents the item on their Amazon page by displaying an Intel box, which potentially misleads a buyer to think that the item will arrive as packaged by Intel. I am so disappointed!
reviews.author: CVTechCare

reviews.title: USED product, not a new processor
reviews.comment: Comes in generic box, not a new product. Showed scuff marks of previous usage
reviews.author: IT Dept
